en: Colorized historic postcard view of a grand town hall with a tall clock tower topped by an ornate dome and smaller domes, red tiled roofs, and a façade with many windows and decorative gables. People in early 20th‑century clothing walk in the square in front of the building. The printed text identifies the town and the building, and there is a red handwritten note along the right side.
